BiblicalUsage: Shamgar killed six hundred Philistines with an ox goad and delivered Israel, and his name is the whole of his story. Deborah's song remembers his days, when the highways were unoccupied and travellers walked through byways.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God uses an ox goad as well as a sword, and a farmer with a stick can deliver a nation when the LORD sends him.
RelatedEvents: Shamgar and the Ox Goad; Deborah and Barak Defeat Sisera
